listing.name: Crash Twinsanity — Crash Twinsanity native (Smartkin/HAB3X) (HAB3X)
listing.summary: The project offers a macOS player and reports sound, movies and saves. Stable 60 FPS and testing on physical Intel Macs remain unfinished. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SLES-52568 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract Crash-Twinsanity-macOS.zip and select your own PAL SLES-52568 ISO in the native player. This is a player package; local source compilation is not required.

warnings: The project offers a macOS player and reports sound, movies and saves. Stable 60 FPS and testing on physical Intel Macs remain unfinished.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
